title: Jesus... My First Salary Came On Diwali Week
topic: his first salary lands in Diwali week and he cannot decide how much to send home without leaving himself stuck

bible.text: Each one should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not out of regret or compulsion. For God loves a cheerful giver.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my first salary landed in Diwali week. How much should I send home? 🙏

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I owe my friend money. Appa never asks me for anything. That’s what scares me.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: He isn’t waiting for a number. He’s waiting to tell his brothers his son remembered.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But if I send too much, I’m stuck next month. Too little, and it feels like pride.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Give what you decided, not what the festival pressures. Cheerful counts; compulsion doesn’t.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: God loves a cheerful giver. Even one sending home for the very first time.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: First salary: how much went home? 👇
